name: Alcaldía de Pasto
body: Made-up paths get a real 404, the page text is in the HTML, and the start page declares Spanish for Colombia. But every page analyzed loads gtag.js twice, for two GA4 IDs, so one visit can land in two reports.
lesson: Keep one GA4 property per site, loaded once, ideally through Tag Manager, and retire the old ID.
summary: www.pasto.gov.co scores 72 out of 100 (C). 1 check fails now, 32 are at risk, and 13 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages read. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: Analytics may count some visits twice
fix.evidence: 20 pages send to more than one GA4 property. 20 pages load gtag.js more than once.
fix.fix: Keep one GA4 property per site and load gtag.js once, or manage it only inside Tag Manager.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages read.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: 20 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /, /index.php/taip, /index.php/participa, /index.php/nuestro-entidad/perfiles-nivel-directivo and 16 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages read. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 20 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
The TLS certificate is valid for 56 more days
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 714 ms
